mkdir -p spec/ui/components/sidebar && cat > spec/ui/components/sidebar/index.pi <<'EOF'
use /lib
from /ui/components/file-tree import FileTreeScope

export scope SidebarScope:
    concept: {SidebarConcept}

concept SidebarConcept:
    pitch:
        A column along the left of the main window's body that holds the
        tools for finding your way around the project.

    shape: {SidebarShape}

shape SidebarShape:
    description:
        Runs the full height of the body, beneath the ribbon, to the left of
        everything else in it. It is resized by dragging its right edge: it
        starts 260 pixels wide and can't be dragged narrower than 160.

    contents:
        fileTree: @{FileTreeScope}
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='spec/scope/application/MainWindow.pi'; s=open(p).read()
def rep(a,b):
    global s
    assert s.count(a)==1,a[:50]; s=s.replace(a,b)
rep('''        sidebar:
            A sidebar along the left of the body holds the @{FileTreeScope}.
            The sidebar is resized by dragging its edge.
''','''        sidebar: @{SidebarScope}
''')
rep('''            right of the sidebar.''','''            right of the @{SidebarScope}.''')
rep('''from /ui/components/file-tree import FileTreeScope
''','''from /ui/components/file-tree import FileTreeScope
from /ui/components/sidebar import SidebarScope
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "FileTreeScope" spec/scope/application/MainWindow.pi; piton check $(find spec -name '*.pi') | tail -1; piton build check | tail -1; grep -n "SIDEBAR_WIDTH\|MIN_SIDEBAR" src/main_window.rs | head -3

content.text:
The sidebar is now its own scope, `SidebarScope` in `spec/ui/components/sidebar/index.pi`, and what goes in it is a reference. `piton check` and `piton build check` pass. I didn't touch `src/`.

**`SidebarScope`:**
- **The sidebar itself:** a column along the left of the window body, full height below the ribbon.
- **Resizing:** by dragging its right edge; it starts 260px wide and can't go below 160px. Those numbers come from the code, and the spec didn't have them before.
- **Contents:** a `contents` section with one entry, `fileTree: @{FileTreeScope}`. Anything added to the sidebar later becomes another entry there.

**`MainWindow.pi`:**
- The sidebar section is now just `sidebar: @{SidebarScope}`.
- The prompt-mode section says it sits to the right of the `SidebarScope`.
- The open-file section still refers to the `FileTreeScope` directly, since it's about clicking a file in the tree rather than the sidebar.
